title: Interaction between moxifloxacin and Mcl-1 and MITF proteins: the effect on growth inhibition and apoptosis in MDA-MB-231 human triple-negative breast cancer cells.
authors: Beberok, Artur; Rok, Jakub; Rzepka, Zuzanna; Marciniec, Krzysztof; Boryczka, Stanislaw; Wrzesniok, Dorota
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和体外实验探讨莫西沙星与MITF/Mcl-1蛋白的相互作用及其对乳腺癌细胞凋亡的影响，虽涉及转录因子MITF和分子对接，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合，且缺乏AI或物理模拟的深度建模，与本课题关联有限。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Microphthalmia-associated transcription factor (MITF) activates the expression of genes involved in cellular proliferation, DNA replication, and repair, whereas Mcl-1 is a member of the Bcl-2 family of proteins that promotes cell survival by preventing apoptosis. The objective of the present study was to verify whether the interaction between moxifloxacin (MFLX), one of the fluoroquinolones, and MITF/Mcl-1 protein, could affect the viability, proliferation, and apoptosis in human breast cancer using both in silico and in vitro models. METHODS: Molecular docking analysis (in silico), fluorescence image cytometry, and Western blot (in vitro) techniques were applied to assess the contribution of MITF and Mcl-1 proteins in the MFLX-induced anti-proliferative and pro-apoptotic effects on the MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cells. RESULTS: We indicated the ability of MFLX to form complexes with MITF and Mcl-1 as well as the drug's capacity to affect the expression of the tested proteins. We also showed that MFLX decreased the viability and proliferation of MDA-MB-231 cells and induced apoptosis via the intrinsic death pathway. Moreover, the analysis of the cell cycle progression revealed that MFLX caused a block in the S and G2/M phases. CONCLUSIONS: We demonstrated for the first time that the observed effects of MFLX on MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cells (growth inhibition and apoptosis induction) could be related to the drug's ability to interact with MITF and Mcl-1 proteins. Furthermore, the presented results suggest that MITF and Mcl-1 proteins could be considered as the target in the therapy of breast cancer.
abstract_zh: 背景：小眼畸形相关转录因子（MITF）激活参与细胞增殖、DNA复制和修复的基因表达，而Mcl-1是Bcl-2蛋白家族成员，通过阻止凋亡促进细胞存活。本研究旨在通过计算机模拟和体外模型，验证氟喹诺酮类药物之一莫西沙星（MFLX）与MITF/Mcl-1蛋白之间的相互作用是否能影响人乳腺癌细胞的活力、增殖和凋亡。方法：应用分子对接分析（计算机模拟）、荧光图像细胞术和Western blot（体外）技术，评估MITF和Mcl-1蛋白在MFLX诱导的MDA-MB-231乳腺癌细胞抗增殖和促凋亡效应中的作用。结果：我们表明MFLX具有与MITF和Mcl-1形成复合物的能力，以及该药物影响所测蛋白表达的能力。我们还显示，MFLX降低了MDA-MB-231细胞的活力和增殖，并通过内源性死亡途径诱导凋亡。此外，细胞周期进程分析揭示，MFLX导致S期和G2/M期阻滞。结论：我们首次证明，MFLX对MDA-MB-231乳腺癌细胞观察到的效应（生长抑制和凋亡诱导）可能与该药物与MITF和Mcl-1蛋白相互作用的能力有关。此外，所呈现的结果提示，MITF和Mcl-1蛋白可被视为乳腺癌治疗中的靶点。
